formats.national: X XXXX XXXX (9 digits, no area codes)

patterns.label: Fixed line (2 = Santiago, other digits by region)

examples.note: Santiago — fixed lines renumbered onto the 2 prefix in 2012–2013
Mobile — the 9 prefix, though portability blurs the fixed/mobile distinction

notes: Chile has no geographic area codes and no trunk prefix — every call within Chile is a local call and all numbers are a flat 9 digits.
Full number portability across fixed, mobile and VoIP means the leading digit no longer reliably identifies the line type.
The international access prefix is carrier-selected in the form 1XX0.
